_comment: Cross-harness payload differences that are known, understood and deliberate.
probe_cross_harness_payload.py fails on anything NOT listed here, so removing an
entry is a visible diff and adding one requires saying why. Written 2026-09-17.

allowed.difference: MolmoSpaces lowercases the instruction; the droid servers pass it through
allowed.cause: pi_policy.py:139 and molmoact2_policy.py:134 call prompt.lower(); openpi/examples/droid/serve_droid.py:192 and molmoact2/examples/droid/host_server_droid.py:196 do not
allowed.bites: Pick-v1.5 and the other bench-v2 tasks, whose task_description is mixed case. Close-v1's is already 'close the drawer.', so this is invisible there
allowed.severity: unquantified -- these are instruction-following VLAs and case is a real token difference. Worth an experiment, not worth blocking on
benign -- float32 epsilon on a radian, four orders of magnitude below the limiter's resolution

allowed.difference: max|d| = 3.7e-09, dtype float32 vs float64, and scalar vs shape (1,)
allowed.cause: same float32 cast; the wrapping difference is cosmetic and openpi's client accepts either
droid/sim/protocol.py carries depth as uint16 millimetres, so the deployment side is quantised to 1 mm; MolmoSpaces hands its wrapper float32 metres straight from the renderer
allowed.severity: 1 mm on a 0.2-2.5 m range. TiPToP reconstructs the table plane to within a centimetre, so this is an order of magnitude inside what its own perception stack resolves
